fusions.name: Overrun
fusions.desc: Runs the target down, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour, rising by 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (up to 30%), and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shouldering Surge
fusions.desc: Shoulders forward through a wide cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 14 damage and knocking everything in it 3.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Bluff Charge
fusions.desc: You surge 3 tiles from where you stood, and your armour rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Draught Frame
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10, and you regain 0.5 health a second.
